step_by_step_reasoning: The whiteboard diagram shows two separate workflows within the Automated Data Analytics (ADA) architecture. The top row represents the user query flow where business users access static content via CloudFront, authenticate through Cognito, and execute queries using Athena. The bottom row depicts the data ingestion and transformation pipeline where incoming data lands in S3, is cataloged by Glue, and has sensitive PII removed using Comprehend.
